values.meaning: Blight stacks applied to target during root
values.quote: they are also inflicted with maximum stacks of ''{{ai|Blighted Quiver|Varus|Blight}}''

values.meaning: time window over which the 3 Blight stacks are applied during the root
values.quote: Over the first {{tt|{{fd|1.75}} seconds|Estimated, see notes for specific stack application timings}} of the root
values.binNote: 1.75s is 3.5x the 0.5s TimeBetweenStackAddition value plus offset; not directly equal but consistent with 3 stacks spaced by that interval as described in notes (0.65s, 1.2s, 1.75s).

mechanics.claim: The tendril infects the first enemy champion hit, dealing damage and rooting them; the root reveals them.
mechanics.quote: unleashes a tendril of corruption in the target direction that infects the first enemy champion hit, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|root|rooting}} them for 2 seconds, during which they are {{tip|standard sight|revealed}}

mechanics.claim: After hitting, the tendril can spread to additional nearby enemy champions, each taking the same damage.
mechanics.quote: A new tendril is then spread out from the infected target that is closest to a nearby uninfected enemy champion... they subsequently become infected as well, taking the same damage and effects.

mechanics.claim: If the root fails to apply (cleanse, CC immunity, spell shield), Blight stacks are not applied and the tendril does not seek further from that target.
mechanics.quote: If the {{tip|root}} is not applied, such as by the target negating its application with {{tip|cc-immune|crowd control immunity}} or a {{tip|spell shield}}, the target will not be inflicted with {{ai|Blighted Quiver|Varus|Blight}} stacks and the tendril will not root into the ground at their location

mechanics.claim: The Blight stacks it applies can be detonated by any Varus ability even without Blighted Quiver being learned, at a rank-0 base of 2.5% of target's maximum health per stack detonated.
mechanics.quote: ''Chain of Corruption'' can generate ''{{ai|Blighted Quiver|Varus|Blight}}'' stacks for '''Varus''' to detonate with any ability, even if ''Blighted Quiver'' has not been learned. The '''base''' detonation damage per ''Blight'' stack scales with ''Blighted Quiver's'' rank, which has a value at rank 0 of {{as|{{fd|2.5}}% of the target's '''maximum''' health}} per stack detonated.

mechanics.claim: If cleansed immediately after root application, no stacks are applied at all.
mechanics.quote: If the target {{tip|cleanse|cleanses}} the root immediately after it is applied, no stacks will be applied.
